title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
May 8, 2025

VIA ELECTRONIC MAIL

The Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, NE
Washington, D.C. 20543

Re: The Hain Celestial Group, et al. v. Sarah Palmquist, et al., No. 24-724

Dear Mr. Harris:

I represent petitioner in the above-captioned case, in which the petition for a writ of
certiorari was granted on April 28, 2025. Petitioners’ opening brief is currently due on June 12,
and respondents’ brief is due on July 14.

Because of scheduling difficulties and the press of other cases, petitioner respectfully
requests, under Rule 30.4 of the Rules of this Court, that the time within which to file petitioners’
opening brief (and the joint appendix, if one is to be filed) be extended to and including June 27,
and the time within which to file respondents’ brief be extended to and including August 11. If
those extensions are granted, petitioners’ reply brief would be due on September 10.

Respondents’ counsel has authorized me to represent that respondents consent to the
proposed briefing schedule.


      Sincerely,

      Sarah E. Harrington


cc:  Russell Post, Counsel for Respondents
